Name: Panning Hats
Author: TimBukTw0
Description:
[size=4]Ever tired of not being able to wear a hat over the pan on your head? Well now you can.
[/size]
[b]Panning Hats[/b] adds a pan slot to every hat in the game. Put your hat on, and a pan slot opens up; ready for your Pan or Milk Pail. And don't worry about losing your pan if you lose your hat. All hats share the same slot, so no matter which hat you're wearing (or not wearing), your pan is always safe in its own little pocket dimension.

FEATURES
- Every hat gets a pan slot. All of them. Even ones that couldn't hide a pan under them.
- Optional dedicated Milk Pail slot via the config so you can have TWO slots.
- Tools persist across hat swaps

It should work in multiplayer but if it doesn't feel free to leave me a bug report!
